1. poorness (noun) /ˈpʊrnəs/: the state or condition of being poor
Example: The family's poorness became evident when they couldn't afford basic necessities.
2. impoverish (verb) /ɪmˈpɑvərɪʃ/: to make poor; to reduce to poverty
Example: The economic crisis threatened to impoverish many working families.
3. poor (adjective) /pʊr/: having little money or few possessions
Example: The poor community struggled to access healthcare and education.
4. poorly (adverb) /ˈpʊrli/: in a poor manner; badly, inadequately
Example: The students performed poorly on the test due to inadequate preparation.

1. creation (noun): the act of creating
2. creator (noun): one who creates
3. creativity (noun): the quality of being creative
4. create (verb) /kriˈeɪt/: to bring something into existence
5. creative (adjective): having the ability to create
